tool_input.command: hops --quiet trino --help 2>&1 | tail -20
hops --quiet --json trino tables --no-verify iceberg.mlpab70fa2d 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "=== schemas ==="; hops --quiet --json trino schemas --no-verify iceberg 2>&1 | tail -15
hops --quiet --json trino tables --no-verify iceberg.mlpab70fa2d_featurestore 2>&1 | tail -15

hops --quiet --json sql --no-verify --schema mlpab70fa2d_featurestore "
SELECT account_id,
       round(1.0/(1.0+exp(-(0.8751*f1 + 0.2859*f2 + 0.8119*f3 + 0.3402))), 6) AS score
FROM (
  SELECT account_id, f1, f2, f3,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time DESC) rn
  FROM feature_history_raw_1
  WHERE event_time <= 1773248400000
) t
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY account_id
" 2>&1 | tail -20
tool_input.description: Compute as-of-T scores via Trino window + sigmoid
